synonyms: Gloomy Neighbor at the Standing Bar
synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. But one day, after coming to the rescue of a college girl who was getting unwelcome attention at the bar, he finds himself sitting next to her every week. From small-talk about daily life to lighthearted complaints… Even though it's just casual conversation, it's so nice to have someone beside you, having a laugh together — it's a romantic comedy that makes you look forward to those Friday nights at the bar, where you feel free to get a little tipsy. titleRomaji: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
titleNative: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
synopsis: Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish. She is a good girl, but she has had problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tried to counsel her, they somehow ended up kissing each other in bed. This is definitely an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into so much trouble that could only lead to her own destruction? — How could I have let this happen? It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow warm relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
titleRomaji: Tonari no Seki no Yankee Shimizu-san ga Kami wo Kuroku Sometekita
titleEnglish: The Delinquent Girl Beside Me Suddenly Dyed Her Hair Black
titleNative: 隣の席のヤンキー清水さんが髪を黒く染めてきた
synonyms: The Delinquent Shimizu-san Sitting Next to Me Has Dyed Her Hair Black
synopsis: Why is the toughest girl in school trying to be my type?! "My type? A girl with long black hair who carries herself well." That's what I told my friends during a casual conversation about romance. The very next day, Shimizu— the blonde delinquent who sits next to me— suddenly shows up with her hair dyed black. From then on, every time I mention my ideal girl, she starts doing things she normally wouldn't— showing up to cooking class (which she used to always skip), packing me homemade lunches, etc. (Source: One Peace Books)
